subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should OpenClaw make the Groq plugin own a matched tool-free 1,024-token retry, or should the shared OpenAI-compatible transport stop treating discovered model maxTokens as the default output reservation?
rationale: Both approaches address the same failure but establish different long-term ownership, tool-capability, and compatibility contracts; automated tests cannot determine the intended product policy.

options.title: Sponsor Groq fallback
options.body: Land this provider-scoped recovery and explicitly accept the matched retry's tool removal, 1,024-token cap, and max-token provenance contract.

options.title: Prefer shared transport policy
options.body: Pause this PR and require the competing transport-level solution to provide equivalent live-provider and cross-provider upgrade proof before becoming canonical.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Groq fallback
recommendation.body: Land this provider-scoped recovery and explicitly accept the matched retry's tool removal, 1,024-token cap, and max-token provenance contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion already routed the cross-provider policy decision to this likely product-direction owner.
